## Pull request overview

This PR fixes TypeScript build errors in three plugin packages by adding explicit type annotations to resolve implicit `any` errors and updating the plugin-dashboard tsconfig.json to allow workspace dependency imports.

**Changes:**
- Added type annotations to ComponentRegistry callback parameters in plugin-chatbot, plugin-charts, and plugin-dashboard to fix implicit `any` errors
- Updated plugin-dashboard/tsconfig.json to remove explicit `rootDir` constraint, matching the pattern used in other plugin packages
- Fixed type narrowing issue in plugin-charts by using an intermediate variable for ChartConfig

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/tsconfig.json | Updated configuration to match other plugin packages (removed rootDir, added baseUrl/paths, reordered options) |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx | Added DashboardWidgetSchema type annotation to map callback parameter |
| packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx | Added inline type annotation to ComponentRegistry.register callback to specify ChatbotSchema and additional props |
| packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx | Fixed type narrowing issue by using intermediate ChartConfig variable before assignment |
